title: Positivity of the Fourier one-norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. If $f$ is not identically zero, then its Fourier one-norm is strictly positive.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
